title: 2.6 Million m² of Moscow Warehouse Space Is Delayed to 2027
subtitle: The postponement covers 46.4% of projects under construction in Moscow and the surrounding region as demand weakens.

supportingFacts.label: Kommersant identifies declining demand as the reason projects are being postponed.

note: Derived total: 2.6 million m² ÷ 46.4% ≈ 5.60 million m².

metadata.keyFinding: Almost half of warehouse space under construction in Moscow and the Moscow region has been postponed to 2027.
